about: This piece belongs to the formulary of the First Sunday of Advent, which opens the liturgical year in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: May we receive Your mercy, O Lord, in the midst of Your temple, that we may precede the coming solemnities of our restoration with fitting honors. Through the Lord.

w012.function: The future participle agrees with “solémnia” (w013) and presents the solemnities as still to come.

w013.function: The adjective stands substantivally for the coming solemn celebrations of restoration.
